topic: Discussion about AI tools and reliability
summary_markdown: The conversation centered on the limitations and unreliability of generative AI tools, specifically referencing ChatGPT. One participant shared an anecdote about using the tool for an online university exam, noting its failure to provide reliable assistance. Another participant agreed with this assessment, describing the tool as having inherent flaws. The discussion also touched upon complex technical projects (like NFT development) that require more than simple extensions.
